# 2. Loading gene annotation files

## - Load check or creation of sqlite file

```{r}
txdb.filename <- "./Resources/GENCODE_v42.annotation.sqlite"

if (file.exists(txdb.filename)) {
  
  sprintf('File %s already exist! Now Loading',txdb.filename)
  txdb <- loadDb(txdb.filename)
  
} else {

  gtf <- "./Resources/GENCODE_v42.annotation.gtf"
  txdb <- makeTxDbFromGFF(gtf)
  
  # We can use saveDb() to save the TxDb database (SQLite database) for later uses
  saveDb(txdb, txdb.filename)
  
  # We can use loadDb() to use the TxDb database
  txdb <- loadDb(txdb.filename)

  sprintf('File %s has been generated!',txdb.filename)

}
```

## - Load check or creation of csv file

```{r}
gencode_gene_info_df.filename <- "./Resources/GENCODE_v42.gene_metadata.csv"

if (file.exists(gencode_gene_info_df.filename)) {
  
  sprintf('File %s already exist!',gencode_gene_info_df.filename)
  Genes_annotation_metadata <- read.csv('./Resources/GENCODE_v42.gene_metadata.csv', header = TRUE)
  rownames(Genes_annotation_metadata) <- Genes_annotation_metadata$gene_id
  
} else {
  
  gtf <- "./Resources/GENCODE_v42.annotation.gtf"
  txdb.filename <- "./Resources/GENCODE_v42.annotation.sqlite"
  txdb <- loadDb(txdb.filename)
  gtf_df <- read.table(file = gtf, sep="\t", header=FALSE)
  gtf_df_genes <- gtf_df %>% dplyr::filter(V3 == 'gene')
  
  # Create an empty dataframe
  gencode_gene_info_df <- data.frame()
  
  for (gene_index in 1:nrow(gtf_df_genes)) {
    gene_info <- gsub(";\\s+", ";", gtf_df_genes[gene_index,'V9'])
    items <- strsplit(gene_info, ";")[[1]]
    
    # Iterate over the items and split each one on the space
    for (item in items) {
      parts <- unlist(strsplit(item, " "))
      if (length(parts) == 2) {
        # If there are exactly two parts, add them to the dataframe as a new column
        gencode_gene_info_df[unlist(strsplit(items[[1]], " "))[[2]],sprintf('%s',parts[1])] <- parts[2]
      }
    }
  }
  write.csv(x = gencode_gene_info_df, file = gencode_gene_info_df.filename, row.names = F)
  sprintf('File %s has been generated!',gencode_gene_info_df.filename)
  
  Genes_annotation_metadata <- read.csv('./Resources/GENCODE_v42.gene_metadata.csv', header = TRUE)
  rownames(Genes_annotation_metadata) <- Genes_annotation_metadata$gene_id
}
```

# 3. Creating or loading sample metadata files

```{r}
Samples_metadata.filename <- "./Resources/Samples_Metadata.csv"

if (file.exists(gencode_gene_info_df.filename)) {

  Samples_metadata <- read.csv(Samples_metadata.filename, row.names = 'X')

} else {
  
  Samples_metadata <- data.frame(row.names = seq(1,28,1))
  for (file in list.files('/data/eoh/kbatta/KB42/Salmon_reads')) {
    index = which(list.files('/data/eoh/kbatta/KB42/Salmon_reads') == file)
    Samples_metadata[index, 'Treatment'] <- str_extract(str_extract(string = file, pattern = "(?<=_Mono_).*$"), ".*?(?=\\_\\d+hrs)")
    Samples_metadata[index, 'Hours'] <- str_extract_all(string = file, pattern = "\\d+hrs")[[1]]
    Samples_metadata[index, 'Sample_ID'] <- str_extract(str_extract(string = file, pattern = "(?<=KB42_).*$"), ".*?(?=\\_\\HB)")
  }
  
  Samples_metadata[21,'Treatment'] <- 'control'
  Samples_metadata[21,'Hours'] <- '24hrs'
  Samples_metadata[21,'Sample_ID'] <- '21'
  Samples_metadata[22,'Treatment'] <- 'LPS'
  Samples_metadata[22,'Hours'] <- '24hrs'
  Samples_metadata[22,'Sample_ID'] <- '22'
  
  rownames(Samples_metadata) <- paste(Samples_metadata$Treatment, Samples_metadata$Sample_ID, Samples_metadata$Hours, sep = '_')
  
  Samples_metadata$Treatment <- factor(Samples_metadata$Treatment, levels = c('control', 'initial', 'LPS', 'resistin'))
  Samples_metadata$Treatment <- relevel(Samples_metadata$Treatment, ref = "control")
  Samples_metadata$Hours <- factor(Samples_metadata$Hours, levels = c('0hrs', '6hrs', '24hrs'))
  Samples_metadata$Hours <- relevel(Samples_metadata$Hours, ref = "0hrs")
  
  Samples_metadata$Comparison <- paste(Samples_metadata$Hours, Samples_metadata$Treatment, sep = '_')
  Samples_metadata$Comparison <- factor(Samples_metadata$Comparison, levels = c('0hrs_initial', '6hrs_control', '24hrs_control', '6hrs_LPS', '24hrs_LPS', '6hrs_resistin', '24hrs_resistin'))
  Samples_metadata$Comparison <- relevel(Samples_metadata$Comparison, ref = "0hrs_initial")
  
  Samples_metadata <- Samples_metadata %>% arrange(Treatment, Hours)
  
  write.csv(x = Samples_metadata, file = "./Resources/Samples_Metadata.csv", row.names = T, quote = F)
  
}
```

# 5. DEG: DESeq2 Analysis

## - Creating DESeq2 object

```{r}
library(DESeq2)
dds = DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi = TXI.Genes, 
                               colData = Samples_metadata,
                               rowData =  Genes_annotation_metadata[rownames(TXI.Genes$counts),], 
                               design = ~ Comparison)
```

## - Exporting unfiltered fpkm

```{r}
write.csv(x = fpkm(dds), file = './Results/Mapped_reads/Normalized_counts/Grouped/Unfiltered/Tximport_FPKM_mat.csv', row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)
```

## - Filtering non-unique uninformative Ensembl.id

The following filtering step removes many non-informative/duplicated genes

```{r}
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds, normalized=TRUE) >= 5 ) >= 3
dds <- dds[keep,]
dds <- DESeq(dds)
```

Few non-unique genes will remain. We filter out duplicates with low baseMean.

```{r}
table(isUnique(rowData(dds)$gene_name))
rowData(dds)[grep(FALSE,isUnique(rowData(dds)$gene_name)),]

df <- as.data.frame(rowData(dds)[grep(FALSE,isUnique(rowData(dds)$gene_name)),])

# Maximum absolute value of Expression by Gene
maxabs <- with(df, aggregate(baseMean, list(gene_name=gene_name), FUN=function(x) max(abs(x))))

# Combine with original data frame
df <- merge(df, maxabs, by="gene_name")

# Get desired rows
df_unique <- subset(df, abs(baseMean) == x)

# Remove duplicate genes (all gene rows should be identical)
df_unique <- df_unique[!duplicated(df_unique$gene_name), ]
```

Now we generate a list of unique genes for the real DESeq2 run

```{r}
unique_genes <- c(rowData(dds)[grep(TRUE,isUnique(rowData(dds)$gene_name)),]$gene_id,
                  df_unique$gene_id)

dir.create(path = './Results/Lists', showWarnings = F)

write.csv(x = data.frame(unique_genes), file = './Results/Lists/List_unique_genes.csv', quote = F, row.names = F)

table(isUnique(unique_genes))
```

Number and proportion of duplicated discarded genes

```{r}
print(table(isUnique(unique_genes))-table(isUnique(rowData(dds)$gene_name))[[2]])
print((table(isUnique(unique_genes))-table(isUnique(rowData(dds)$gene_name))[[2]])/table(isUnique(unique_genes)))
```

## - Running DESeq2 with unique genes

## - Testing parametric dispersion vs local

```{r}
dds_parametric = DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi = TXI.Genes, 
                               colData = Samples_metadata,
                               rowData = Genes_annotation_metadata[rownames(TXI.Genes$counts),], 
                               design = ~ Comparison)
dds_parametric <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_parametric)
dds_parametric <- dds_parametric[unique_genes,]
dds_parametric <- DESeq(dds_parametric, fitType = "parametric")

Residuals_parametric <- log(mcols(dds_parametric)$dispGeneEst)-log(mcols(dds_parametric)$dispFit)
plotDispEsts(dds_parametric, main= "dispEst: Parametric")
hist(x = Residuals_parametric, xlim = c(-20,10))
Median_Absolute_Residual_parametric <- median(abs(log(mcols(dds_parametric)$dispGeneEst)-log(mcols(dds_parametric)$dispFit)))


dds_local = DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi = TXI.Genes, 
                               colData = Samples_metadata,
                               rowData= Genes_annotation_metadata[rownames(TXI.Genes$counts),], 
                               design = ~ Comparison)
dds_local <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_local)
dds_local <- dds_local[unique_genes,]
dds_local <- DESeq(dds_local, fitType = "local")

Residuals_local <- log(mcols(dds_local)$dispGeneEst)-log(mcols(dds_local)$dispFit)
plotDispEsts(dds_local, main= "dispEst: Local")
hist(x = Residuals_local, xlim = c(-20, 10))
Median_Absolute_Residual_local <- median(abs(log(mcols(dds_local)$dispGeneEst)-log(mcols(dds_local)$dispFit)))


if ((Median_Absolute_Residual_parametric < Median_Absolute_Residual_local) == TRUE) {
  Best_scoring_fitType <- 'parametric'
} else {
  Best_scoring_fitType <- 'local'
}
```

## - Re-running DESeq2 with optimal parameter

```{r}
dds = DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi = TXI.Genes, 
                               colData = Samples_metadata,
                               rowData = Genes_annotation_metadata[rownames(TXI.Genes$counts),], 
                               design = ~ Comparison)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
dds <- dds[unique_genes,]
dds <- DESeq(dds, fitType = Best_scoring_fitType)
```

rv <- rowVars(assay(rlog))
# select the ntop genes by variance

# perform a PCA on the data in assay(x) for the selected genes

pca_samples$Sample_ID <- colData(dds)[rownames(pca_samples),'Sample_ID']

## - Identification of DEGs

### - Loading additional gene metadata

```{r}
TF_list <- read.csv('./Resources/Gene_Metadata_Lambert2018_TFs.txt', sep = '\t', header = F)

HGNC_CD_markers_list <- read.csv('./Resources/Gene_Metadata_HGNC_CD_Markers.csv')
```

### - Performing comparison

```{r}
dir.create("./Results/DEG", showWarnings = F)

for (condition_A in levels(dds$Comparison)) {
  
  results <- list()
  dds$Comparison <- relevel(dds$Comparison, condition_A)
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  
  for (condition_B in setdiff(dds$Comparison, condition_A)) {
    
    name_comparison <- paste("Comparison_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, sep = '')
    res <- results(dds, name = name_comparison, filterFun = ihw)
    res <- as.data.frame(res)
    res <- add_column(.data = res, .before= 'baseMean', Gene= rowData(dds)[which(rowData(dds)$gene_id == rownames(res)),'gene_name'])
    
    res_significant <- res %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.5)
    res_significant$Rank <- -log10(res_significant$padj) * res_significant$log2FoldChange
    res_significant$Rank <- Mod(res_significant$Rank)
    res_significant$Is_TF <- 'No'
    res_significant[grep(TRUE, res_significant$Gene %in% TF_list$V1),'Is_TF'] <- 'Yes'
    res_significant$Is_CD_marker <- 'No'
    res_significant[grep(TRUE, res_significant$Gene %in% HGNC_CD_markers_list$Approved.symbol),'Is_CD_marker'] <- 'Yes'
    
    results[[name_comparison]] <- res_significant %>% arrange(-Rank)
    
    write.csv(x = res_significant %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% arrange(-Rank), file = paste("./Results/DEG/", 'DESeq2', '_', name_comparison, '__UP_in_', condition_B, '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = T)
    write.csv(x = res_significant %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% arrange(-Rank), file = paste("./Results/DEG/", 'DESeq2', '_', name_comparison, '__UP_in_', condition_A, '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = T)
    write.csv(x = res, file = paste("./Results/DEG/", 'DESeq2', '_', name_comparison, '__ALL', '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = T)
  }
}
```

percentVar = round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))

png(filename = '/Users/kristiangurashi/Dropbox (The University of Manchester)/Projects data/Project__Christie_BP_CMML_Stratification_and_Drug_Prediction/04__Christie_BP_CMML_BulkRNAseq/01__DESeq2_Post_STAR_Salmon_Processing/Results/Figures/DGE_BP-CMML_vs_Control_PCA.png', width = 1500, height = 1250, units = 'px', res = 300)
ggplot(pcaData, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = Treatment)) + 
geom_point(size = 2) + theme_bw() +
geom_text_repel(aes(label = name), nudge_x = -1, nudge_y = 0.2, size = 3) +
ggtitle("Principal Component Analysis (PCA)", subtitle = "rlog transformation") +
xlab(paste0("PC1: ",percentVar[1],"% variance")) +

dev.off()

# 6. Vulcano plots

## - CTRL 24hrs v LPS 24hrs

```{r}
DESeq2_results <- read.csv('./Results/DEG/DESeq2_Comparison_24hrs_LPS_vs_24hrs_control__ALL.csv')
CTRL_24hrs_results <- read.csv('./Results/DEG/DESeq2_Comparison_24hrs_LPS_vs_24hrs_control__UP_in_24hrs_control.csv', row.names = 'X')
LPS_24hrs_results <- read.csv('./Results/DEG/DESeq2_Comparison_24hrs_LPS_vs_24hrs_control__UP_in_24hrs_LPS.csv', row.names = 'X')

genemat_ord <- DESeq2_results
genemat_ord$Log10pval <- log10(genemat_ord$padj)
genemat_ord$log10FoldChange <- log10(2^genemat_ord$log2FoldChange)

# plot adding up all layers we have seen so far

  keyvals <- ifelse(
    genemat_ord$log2FoldChange < 0 & genemat_ord$pvalue < 10e-2, '#415384',
      ifelse(genemat_ord$log2FoldChange > 0 & genemat_ord$pvalue < 10e-2, '#C92A1D',
        '#727272'))
  keyvals[is.na(keyvals)] <- '#e5e5e5'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == '#C92A1D'] <- 'Upregulated'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == '#727272'] <- 'NS'
  names(keyvals)[keyvals == '#415384'] <- 'Downregulated'

LPS_Genes <- (LPS_24hrs_results %>% arrange(padj))[1:10, 'Gene']
Control_Genes <- (CTRL_24hrs_results %>% arrange(padj))[1:10, 'Gene']

png(filename = './Results/Figures/DESeq2_TOPDEGs_CTRL_24hrs_vs_LPS_24hrs.png',units = 'in', width = 4.6, height = 5.2, res = 300)

EnhancedVolcano(genemat_ord,
    lab = genemat_ord$Gene,
    x = 'log2FoldChange',
    y = 'pvalue',
    cutoffLineCol = "grey10",
    cutoffLineWidth = 0,
    selectLab = c(LPS_Genes, Control_Genes),
    xlab = bquote(~Log[2]~ 'fold change'),
    pCutoff = 10e-2,
    FCcutoff = 0,
    vlineWidth = 0,
    pointSize = 2.0, 
    xlim = c(-max(c(max(LPS_24hrs_results$log2FoldChange), max(CTRL_24hrs_results$log2FoldChange))),
             max(c(max(LPS_24hrs_results$log2FoldChange), max(CTRL_24hrs_results$log2FoldChange)))),
    ylim = c(-0.5,max(c(max(-log10(LPS_24hrs_results$pvalue)), max(-log10(CTRL_24hrs_results$pvalue))))),
    hline = 10e-2,
    labSize = 2.0,
    labCol = keyvals[grep(TRUE,genemat_ord$Gene %in% c(LPS_Genes, Control_Genes),)],
    labFace = 'bold',
    caption = NULL,
    boxedLabels = TRUE,
    colAlpha = 4/5,
    legendPosition = 'bottom',
    legendLabSize = 3.5,
    legendIconSize = 1.0,
    drawConnectors = TRUE,
    widthConnectors = 0.5,
    colConnectors = 'black',
    colCustom = keyvals) + ggtitle(label = '', subtitle = '') +
  theme_bw(base_line_size = 0.2) + 
  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(family='Helvetica', size = 12, face = 'bold'),
        axis.title.x = element_text(family='Helvetica', size = 12, face = 'bold'), 
        plot.title = element_text(family='Helvetica', size = 12, face = 'bold'), 
        legend.position = 'bottom') + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = ''))

dev.off()
```

# 7. Pathway analysis: fGSEA

## - Gene ranking

```{r}
dir.create(path = './Results/fGSEA', showWarnings = F)

for (condition_A in levels(dds$Comparison)) {
    for (condition_B in setdiff(dds$Comparison, condition_A)) {
      
        name_comparison <- paste("Comparison_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, sep = '')
        print(paste("./Results/DEG/", 'DESeq2', '_', name_comparison, '__ALL', '.csv', sep = ''))
        
        DEGS <- read.csv(paste("./Results/DEG/", 'DESeq2', '_', name_comparison, '__ALL', '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = 'X')
        
        DEGS$Rank <- sign(DEGS$log2FoldChange)*(-1*log10(DEGS$pvalue))
        
        DEGS <- DEGS %>% arrange(-Rank)
        
        Ranks <- DEGS$Rank
        names(Ranks) <- DEGS$Gene
        Ranks <- Ranks[grep(FALSE,is.na(Ranks))]
        
        ## - Hallmark analysis
        
        Hallmark_pathways_gmt_file <- "./Resources/Reference_Signatures/h.all.v2022.1.Hs.symbols.gmt.txt"
        Hallmark_pathways <- gmtPathways(Hallmark_pathways_gmt_file)
        str(head(Hallmark_pathways))
        
        fgseaRes_Hallmark <- fgsea(pathways = Hallmark_pathways, 
                                   stats = Ranks, 
                                   minSize=10, 
                                   maxSize = 500, 
                                   nPermSimple = 10000)
        
        fgseaRes_Hallmark <- fgseaRes_Hallmark %>% arrange(padj)
        fgseaRes_Hallmark$leadingEdge <- NULL
        
        write.csv(x = fgseaRes_Hallmark, file = paste("./Results/fGSEA/fGSEA_H_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, "__ALL.csv", sep = ""), row.names = F)
        
        write.csv(x = fgseaRes_Hallmark %>% filter(NES > 0), file = paste("./Results/fGSEA/fGSEA_H_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, "__Up_in_", condition_B, ".csv", sep = ""), row.names = F)
        
        write.csv(x = fgseaRes_Hallmark %>% filter(NES < 0), paste("./Results/fGSEA/fGSEA_H_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, "__Up_in_", condition_A, ".csv", sep = ""), row.names = F)
        
        ## - Canonical pathway analysis
        
        CanonicalPathways_gmt_file <- "./Resources/Reference_Signatures/c2.cp.v2022.1.Hs.symbols.gmt.txt"
        CanonicalPathways <- gmtPathways(CanonicalPathways_gmt_file)
        str(head(CanonicalPathways))
        
        fgseaRes_CP <- fgsea(pathways = CanonicalPathways, 
                             stats = Ranks, 
                             minSize=10, 
                             maxSize = 500, 
                             nPermSimple = 10000)
        
        fgseaRes_CP <- fgseaRes_CP %>% arrange(padj)
        fgseaRes_CP$leadingEdge <- NULL
        
        
        write.csv(x = fgseaRes_CP, file = paste("./Results/fGSEA/fGSEA_CP_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, "__ALL.csv", sep = ""), row.names = F)
        
        write.csv(x = fgseaRes_CP %>% filter(NES > 0), file = paste("./Results/fGSEA/fGSEA_CP_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, "__Up_in_", condition_B, ".csv", sep = ""), row.names = F)
        
        write.csv(x = fgseaRes_CP %>% filter(NES < 0), paste("./Results/fGSEA/fGSEA_CP_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, "__Up_in_", condition_A, ".csv", sep = ""), row.names = F)
        
        ## - GO BP pathway analysis
        
        GO_BP_gmt_file <- "./Resources/Reference_Signatures/c5.go.bp.v2022.1.Hs.symbols.gmt.txt"
        GOBP_pathways <- gmtPathways(GO_BP_gmt_file)
        str(head(GOBP_pathways))
        
        fgseaRes_GO_BP <- fgsea(pathways = GOBP_pathways, 
                                stats = Ranks, 
                                minSize=10, 
                                maxSize = 500, 
                                nPermSimple = 10000)
        
        fgseaRes_GO_BP <- fgseaRes_GO_BP %>% arrange(padj)
        fgseaRes_GO_BP$leadingEdge <- NULL
        
        
        write.csv(x = fgseaRes_GO_BP, file = paste("./Results/fGSEA/fGSEA_GO_BP_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, "__ALL.csv", sep = ""), row.names = F)
        
        write.csv(x = fgseaRes_GO_BP %>% filter(NES > 0), file = paste("./Results/fGSEA/fGSEA_GO_BP_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, "__Up_in_", condition_B, ".csv", sep = ""), row.names = F)
        
        write.csv(x = fgseaRes_GO_BP %>% filter(NES < 0), paste("./Results/fGSEA/fGSEA_GO_BP_", condition_B, "_vs_", condition_A, "__Up_in_", condition_A, ".csv", sep = ""), row.names = F)
    }
}
```

# 8. Identifying marker genes for each condition

## - Creating dds object without intercept

```{r}
dds = DESeqDataSetFromTximport(txi = TXI.Genes, 
                               colData = Samples_metadata,
                               rowData = Genes_annotation_metadata[rownames(TXI.Genes$counts),], 
                               design = ~0 + Comparison)
dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
dds <- dds[unique_genes,]
dds <- DESeq(dds, fitType = Best_scoring_fitType)
```

## - Performing comparison

```{r}
results <- list()

for (condition in resultsNames(dds)) {
  
  name_condition <- gsub("Comparison", "", condition)
  name_comparison <- paste("Comparison_", name_condition, "_vs_ALL", sep = '')
  
  res <- results(dds, contrast = list(c(condition),setdiff(resultsNames(dds), condition)), listValues=c(1, -1/7), filterFun = ihw)
  res <- as.data.frame(res)
  res <- add_column(.data = res, .before= 'baseMean', Gene= rowData(dds)[which(rowData(dds)$gene_id == rownames(res)),'gene_name'])
    
  res_significant <- res %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.5)
  res_significant$Rank <- -log10(res_significant$padj) * res_significant$log2FoldChange
  res_significant$Rank <- Mod(res_significant$Rank)
  res_significant$Is_TF <- 'No'
  res_significant[grep(TRUE, res_significant$Gene %in% TF_list$V1),'Is_TF'] <- 'Yes'
  res_significant$Is_CD_marker <- 'No'
  res_significant[grep(TRUE, res_significant$Gene %in% HGNC_CD_markers_list$Approved.symbol),'Is_CD_marker'] <- 'Yes'
    
  results[[name_comparison]] <- res_significant %>% arrange(-Rank)
    
  write.csv(x = res_significant %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% arrange(-Rank), file = paste("./Results/DEG/", 'DESeq2', '_', name_comparison, '__UP_in_', name_condition, '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = T)
  write.csv(x = res_significant %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% arrange(-Rank), file = paste("./Results/DEG/", 'DESeq2', '_', name_comparison, '__UP_in_rest', '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = T)
  write.csv(x = res, file = paste("./Results/DEG/", 'DESeq2', '_', name_comparison, '__ALL', '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = T)
    
}
```

## - Heatmap 30 genes per condition

### - Loading marker genes

```{r}
Genes_to_plot <- list()

for (condition in resultsNames(dds)) {

  name_condition <- gsub("Comparison", "", condition)
  name_comparison <- paste("Comparison_", name_condition, "_vs_ALL", sep = '')
  DEG <- read.csv(paste("./Results/DEG/", 'DESeq2', '_', name_comparison, '__UP_in_', name_condition, '.csv', sep = ''), row.names = 'X')
  Genes_to_plot[[name_comparison]] <- (DEG %>% arrange(padj))$Gene[1:30]
  
}
```

### - Plotting heatmap

```{r}
rlog_results <- read.csv('./Results/Mapped_reads/Normalized_counts/Grouped/Filtered/DESeq2_rlog_normalized_countmat.csv', row.names = 'X')

colnames(rlog_results) <- str_replace_all(colnames(rlog_results), pattern = 'X', replacement = '')

rlog_results_to_keep <- rlog_results[grep(TRUE,rlog_results$GeneSymbol %in% unique(unlist(Genes_to_plot))),]

rownames(rlog_results_to_keep) <- rlog_results_to_keep$GeneSymbol
rlog_results_to_keep$GeneSymbol <- NULL
rlog_results_to_keep$GeneBiotype <- NULL

rlog_results_to_keep_mat <- as.matrix(rlog_results_to_keep)

rlog_results_to_keep_mat_top30 <- rlog_results_to_keep_mat[unique(unlist(Genes_to_plot)),]
scaled_genemat_ord_GeneSymbol <- t(scale(t(rlog_results_to_keep_mat_top30)))[,]
scaled_genemat_ord_GeneSymbol <- t(scaled_genemat_ord_GeneSymbol)

Phenotype_identity <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(dds))

Phenotype_identity$Comparison <- dds$Comparison

Phenotype_identity$Comparison <- factor(Phenotype_identity$Comparison, levels = c('0hrs_initial', '6hrs_control', '24hrs_control', '6hrs_LPS', '24hrs_LPS', '6hrs_resistin', '24hrs_resistin'))

colors_annotation <-  list(Comparison = c('0hrs_initial' = '#A4BECE',
                                          '6hrs_control' = '#669bbc',
                                          '24hrs_control' = '#003049',
                                          '6hrs_LPS' = '#87c38f',
                                          '24hrs_LPS' = '#226f54',
                                          '6hrs_resistin' = '#c1121f',
                                          '24hrs_resistin' = '#780000'))

ha <- rowAnnotation(df=Phenotype_identity, col = colors_annotation, 
                        gp = gpar(lwd =0.5, col = 'white'),
                        simple_anno_size = unit(0.25, 'cm'),
                        show_annotation_name = F, show_legend = FALSE,
                        annotation_legend_param = list(Comparison = list(direction = "horizontal")))

# Working on the rest of the heatmap

breaks_val <- seq(from = -1.5, to = 2, length.out = 13)
col_heatmap_guide <- colorRamp2(breaks = breaks_val,colors = rev(brew_mix))

set.seed(123)

Heatmap_genes <- Heatmap(scaled_genemat_ord_GeneSymbol, name = 'Scaled\nExpression',
                            col = col_heatmap_guide,
                            show_row_names = FALSE, 
                            show_column_names = T,
                            cluster_columns = TRUE,
                            cluster_rows = TRUE,
                            row_split = Phenotype_identity$Comparison,
                            border = TRUE,
                            cluster_row_slices = TRUE,
                            row_gap = unit(0.05, 'cm'),
                            column_gap = unit(0.05, 'cm'),
                            show_column_dend = F, 
                            row_dend_side = 'right',
                            column_names_side = 'bottom',
                            use_raster = FALSE, 
                            rect_gp = gpar(col = "black", lwd = 0.05),
                            raster_by_magick = TRUE, 
                            left_annotation = ha,
                            row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, angle=45),
                            row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, hjust=0),
                            column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12),
                            column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, hjust=0),
                            show_heatmap_legend = F,
                            heatmap_legend_param = list(
                                      legend_direction = "horizontal", 
                                      legend_width = unit(5, "cm")))

png(file = './Results/Figures/DGE_Top_30_UP_DEGs_per_condition.png', width = 13, height = 7, units = 'in', res = 300)

draw(Heatmap_genes, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", 
     annotation_legend_side = "bottom")

dev.off()
```
